interpretation_hint: A proposed transition of a running flow instance from one state to another, awaiting consensus. Carries the DID of the proposer, the URIs of instances offered as evidence for the target state's `requires`, and a hash snapshot of each cited instance's content so downstream verifiers can detect post-proposal edits. A proposal into a terminal state also names the run's outputs as (class, id) pairs and signs a hash over their content. The proposal's URI is the content address of its signed fields, salted by the proposer's nonce, so a co-signature on the URI covers them all. `proposer` is read only from a proposer link signed by the DID it names, as the engine reads it. The voters are the set of the proposer (whose vote is implicit) and `acceptedBy`, which lists each DID whose acceptance link is signed by that DID, once; only those count. `resolvedAs` is this replica's own Local record that the engine fired the proposal.

properties.name: proposer
properties.getter: SELECT ?target WHERE { ?source <ad4m://flow/proposer> ?target . FILTER EXISTS { ?_claim <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#reifies> <<( ?source <ad4m://flow/proposer> ?target )>> ; <ad4m://ontology/author> ?_author ; <ad4m://ontology/proofValid> ?_valid . FILTER(STR(?_author) = STR(?target) && STR(?_valid) = "true") } }

properties.name: acceptedBy
properties.getter: SELECT ?target WHERE { ?source <ad4m://acceptedBy> ?target . FILTER EXISTS { ?_vote <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#reifies> <<( ?source <ad4m://acceptedBy> ?target )>> ; <ad4m://ontology/author> ?_author ; <ad4m://ontology/proofValid> ?_valid . FILTER(STR(?_author) = STR(?target) && STR(?_valid) = "true") } }
